To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) YY Men is an active, magnetically variable, and chemically peculiar star with a hot corona, (2) its coronal abundance pattern is consistent with the inverse FIP effect, (3) its corona is dominated (in terms of EM) by a high-temperature plasma, (4) its coronal emission measure distribution is consistent with a large number of small flares, (5) YY Men is a good candidate for the detection of flares with peak X

YY Mensae is a magnetically active giant star, with a corona that is hotter than the corona of most active stars, and that shows a strong inverse FIP effect.
